AppRef.description: The app something belongs to: its stable id plus the name to show.

display_name.description: The ARP `DisplayName` at the time of the reference (the key name when the entry has none).

Expiry.description:
When each class of a session's data expires. Expiry only proposes; nothing is deleted on these dates
without a prompt.

backups.description: When the registry backups and definitions expire (start + 180 days).

quarantine.description: When the quarantined files expire (start + 30 days).

FileTime.description:
A point in time as a Windows `FILETIME`: 100-nanosecond intervals since 1601-01-01 UTC.

This is what registry key LastWriteTime, file times and process start times are in, so nothing is
converted on the way in. Serialised as a plain integer.

JournalMark.description:
How far a session's journal reached when the index entry was written: its number of lines (the header
included) and the hash-chain value of the last of them.

head.description: The `chain` value of the last of them.

records.description: Complete lines in the journal, the header included.

OutcomeCounts.description: How many items ended in each [`ItemOutcome`]. Every field reads as 0 when missing.

ProgramId.description: <hive tag>|<view>|<key name>, e.g. HKLM|64|Git_is1 or HKU:<sid>|64|{guid}

RetentionClass.description: What a retention period applies to (§7.8).

oneOf.description: The journal and the session's reports: [`RETAIN_JOURNAL_DAYS`].

SessionId.description: UTC start time and 64 random bits, e.g. 20261115T101502Z-9f3a6c1d2b7e4a50

oneOf.description:
The journal has neither a commit nor an aborted record: the run is in progress, or it crashed and
waits for recovery.
The run finished and was committed.
The run stopped early (a backup or journal write failed); items after the stop are untouched.
Every op that changed the system was undone.
Some ops were undone; others remain, or ended in a conflict.

SessionSummary.description:
One session in the index: enough for the history list and the expiry notice, without reading the
journal.

app.description: The app id of the plan that was executed.

backup_bytes.description: Bytes of quarantine and backup data the session still holds, over all volumes.

counts.description: How many items ended in each outcome.

expires.description: When each class of the session's data expires.

finished.description: When the run was committed or aborted; `None` while the session is open.

journal.description:
Where the session's journal stood when this entry was written: a reader of the journal checks
that it still holds that many lines with that chain value at the last of them, so a journal cut
at a line boundary is detected (review M7). `None` in entries written before the field existed.

owner.description: The app the plan's items belong to, when the plan names one.

pending_reboot.description: Whether a boot-time move of this session still waits for a restart.

plan_hash.description: The hash of the executed plan.

purged.description: The classes whose data has already been deleted by a confirmed expiry.

undone.description: How many ops have been undone.

VolumeCap.description: Quarantine usage and cap of one volume.

used.description: Bytes the quarantine holds on it.

VolumeUsage.description: How many bytes a session holds on one volume. The size cap (§7.8) is per volume.

bytes.description: Bytes of quarantine and backup data the session holds on the volume.

root.description: Root of the volume as it was mounted during the run, e.g. `C:\`. For display only.
